text:
zoe (security): alert from nightly audit: ~2k objects under staging/backups have no CMK metadata. tagging eng-sec and encops.
k8s-bot: ALERT storage-audit: 2,043 objects missing CMEK headers in s3://redwood-staging-backups/2026-03 (rule: require-cmek)

rana (encops): ugh. any correlation with deploys or config changes?

zoe (security): initial scan shows spike starting Mar 19 03:00 UTC. keys look like backups/tenant-9/.. and snapshots/tenant-83/..

li (sre): we did a quick rollback on uploader-service last week. maybe a config flag defaulted. i'll check helm history.

omar (platform): looking at infra: there was an emergency toggle in uploader helm: `CMEK_ENABLED` was flipped to `false` for a rollback test and a webhook that injects headers was temporarily removed. ops failed to re-add it.

rana (encops): so uploads fell back to SSE-S3 or no metadata. need to know: are objects actually unencrypted or encrypted with SSE-S3? that changes restore implications.

zoe (security): sample object head responses show no x-amz-server-side-encryption header present -> unencrypted.

li (sre): that's bad. compliance hit. recommended immediate steps:
- pause uploader service (add namespace admission deny) to stop further bad uploads
- collect per-tenant list and owners
- plan re-encrypt job (S3 copy with SSE-KMS) using ephemeral KMS grants

omar (platform): for the re-encrypt job we need kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt permissions. i can create a short-lived grant and a service principal for the rewriter. prefer grant approach over editing key policy.
rana (encops): agree. rewriter workflow:
1) dry-run list and verify ACLs
2) create grant for rewriter principal
3) copy objects in batches with `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` and kms-key-id header
4) write manifest with original metadata and checksums to compliance bucket
5) revoke grant

zoe (security): ensure every copy includes correlation-id and operator identity for audit. escalate if any objects fail ACL checks—could indicate tenant-owned ACLs blocking re-writes.

li (sre): note: multipart uploads older than 30d require part-wise rewrite. i'll mark them as special-case in the ticket.

omar (platform): immediate mitigation: re-enable webhook and redeploy uploader with CMEK_ENABLED=true. i'll push an emergency PR and enact a CI gate to fail merges that set CMEK_ENABLED=false for staging/prod.

rana (encops): also add a metric/alert: percent of uploads without x-amz-server-side-encryption > 0.1% triggers paging.

zoe (security): i've created INC-20260322-encops and notified compliance. attaching initial tenant list will follow.

li (sre): i'll run a restore test on tenant-83 after batch 1 completes. expecting ETA 3h. assigning to me.

omar (platform): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/441 - emergency rollback and CI guard. running grant script shortly.

rana (encops): starting grant/create-copy job in dry-run mode now. posting logs to the incident ticket. will include counts and time estimates.

zoe (security): postmortem expectations: document IAM prune process (we had an IAM prune two days ago), require manual sign-off before role removal for uploader SA, and include a replay of audit detection and re-encrypt timeline.

k8s-bot: Mitigation: webhook re-enabled for namespace uploader-v2 at 19:12 UTC.

li (sre): update: dry-run found 1,812 eligible objects and 231 multipart legacy objects. proceeding with batch-1 of 500 objects.

rana (encops): batch-1 started with ephemeral grant id G-9c3a. copying 500 objects. will revoke grant at completion. logs -> INC-20260322-encops.

zoe (security): thanks. i'll draft compliance notification and add tenant POCs. keep updates in incident ticket only.

li (sre): batch-1 complete. sampled 10 objects, restore succeeded with CMK decrypt. moving to batch-2. ETA full run ~6h.

rana (encops): grant revoked G-9c3a at 20:05 UTC. creating follow-on grant for next batch.

omar (platform): CI guard merged. will also add automated pre-merge check to infra-lint to detect CMEK_ENABLED=false in prod charts.

zoe (security): closing loop for now but assigning postmortem to me. primary action items: RBAC sign-off for IAM prunes, webhook availability test, re-encrypt playbook, and alerting refinement.

k8s-bot: Incident INC-20260322-encops updated: mitigation in progress.
